source_snapshot.procedure: Configure IPv4, verify address/LED, ping peer, remove cable, recheck address/LED.
source_snapshot.criteria: Address correct/LED on/ping succeeds; after removal address disabled and LED off.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires isolated mapping/address/peer, cable/LED operator, OOB, rollback and disabled-semantics clarification.

old_problem: The phrase 'IP addresses should be disable' conflated retained IPv4 assignment with carrier and reachability loss after cable removal.
disposition_reason: Linux kernel operational-state documentation distinguishes administrative/configuration state from carrier-dependent ability to transfer data: an unplugged Ethernet link is IF_OPER_DOWN. Thus the criterion is normalized to carrier/neighbor/route usability and peer reachability being unavailable, without requiring deletion of a static IPv4 address. Port/address/peer remain runtime bindings.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row66 all18 XLSX cells and history2677.
Applied Linux kernel operational-state semantics; preserved configured address before unplug and down/unreachable behavior after unplug.
Kept operator cable/LED evidence and reconnect/rollback; no network or physical action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Mellanox IPv4 configuration, cable-loss and LED recovery validation
test_case.purpose: Verify approved IPv4 configuration and peer reachability on an isolated Mellanox port, then prove carrier/traffic/LED loss on unplug and safe recovery after reconnect.
required_package: Physical-port/MAC/BDF/netdev/cable mapping and vendor LED table
Conflict-free IPv4/prefix/route/peer plan on a non-management path
Independent OOB/console and operator for exact cable/LED photos
Carrier/neighbor/ping down and reconnect recovery timeouts
Baseline IPv4/link state, rollback and invalid-run policy
test_case.test_command: Capture baseline link/IPv4/routes/neighbors; apply only the approved temporary IPv4 configuration, verify no duplicate and ping the mapped peer, and record LED-on photo. Operator unplugs the exact cable; verify carrier/operstate down, peer ping failure and LED-off photo while separately recording whether the static address remains. Reconnect, prove bounded carrier/neighbor/ping recovery and restore baseline.
test_case.expected_result: Configured IPv4 is correct and reaches the peer with link/LED up; unplug produces operational down, unusable peer path and LED off; reconnect recovers; baseline configuration is restored without errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires correct IPv4/peer, real LED/cable evidence, carrier and reachability loss, bounded recovery and rollback. Retained static address while carrier is down is normal and not a failure.
safety_gate: Use only the mapped non-management port and conflict-free address.
Operator owns cable handling and physical LED capture.
Require independent OOB and baseline rollback before configuration.
Abort on duplicate address, wrong cable, management impact or recovery timeout; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Unplug carrier/operstate/ping failure plus LED-off photo
Reconnect recovery timeline and LED/link evidence
test_case.recovery: If the wrong cable is removed or IPv4/link fails to recover, stop, reconnect only the mapped cable, use OOB to restore recorded address/routes/admin state, preserve carrier/neighbor/ping/LED evidence, and require network-owner review before repeating.

source_conflict.reason: Official Linux semantics resolve disabled as operational carrier/reachability loss, not mandatory address deletion.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; mapping/address/peer/operator and timeouts gate execution.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind port/cable, IPv4/peer, LED mapping, timeouts, OOB and rollback.
pending.unlock_condition: No Engineering Decision remains; incomplete project bindings prevent execution/PASS.

external_authorities.name: Linux kernel Operational States
external_authorities.use: Defines separate administrative and operational states and IF_OPER_DOWN for unplugged Ethernet unable to transfer data.

project_authority: Exact port/address/peer/LED and rollback are project inputs.
